description: An app connected to a host process (one that's subscribed: Baude, Record, the Android app; or an Emission there), by the code it runs. Those on the same code are one.

client.description: What it is, as its hello says (baude, record, emission, baude-android, ...).

commit.description: The commit its code is, as its hello says (null: it didn't say).

made.description: When that commit was made, in seconds, as the host's git has it (null: it hasn't it).

behind.description: In a host's info only: how many commits it lacks of the mesh's newest code (MeshView's newest), as that host's git counts them (null: it can't).
